title.en: An Act Declaring September 9 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Mina, Province of Iloilo, in Commemoration of its Founding Day

text.en: September 9 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Municipality of Mina, Province of Iloilo, in commemoration of its founding day. Upon proclamation of the President, September 9 of every year shall be a special nonworking holiday in the Municipality of Mina, Province of Iloilo.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
